newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: ENZA, Zespri International to work together more.
newsitem.headline: ENZA, Zespri International to work together more.

text.p: The Apple and Pear Marketing Board and the Kiwifruit Marketing Board on Wednesday announced plans to work closer together to boost grower returns.
The two board's respective marketing arms, Enza and Zespri International, said the plans would maximise competitive advantage and allow them to save money through sharing resources.
Enza chief executive Gary Smith and his counterpart at Zespri, Robin Mills, said they both were in the business of creating long-term value for their shareholders.

"Given international market pressures, increasing competition worldwide, and the impact of foreign-exchange movements on our returns, we see the time as right to work more closely together to boost grower returns through efficiency gains," they said in a statement.
A joint taskforce will look at boosting efficiency through cooperation in three key areas: information technology, global logistics, and offshore sales and marketing.
A joint Enza and Zespri sales strategy in the lucrative British market will be run as a pilot project during the 1997 selling season, with a view to rolling it out to global markets from 1998.

The move is in line with recommendations made over two years ago to the kiwifruit industry for it to overcome the problem of a narrow product range by merging or forming alliances with other fruit exporters.
